note: Mitchell County Conservation campground on the east bank of the Little Cedar River at Stacyville, renovated 2021: natural playscape with a treehouse, a small swimming pond with beaches, prairie trails and a small-craft boat ramp. The sites at the north end by the boat ramp look across the ramp area to the river; the rest are screened by bank trees or set back. mycountyparks lists 'Pets prohibited' among the park's features while the camping contract gives leash rules, so ask before bringing a pet. --Claude
